Guided by the four official mission segments (User, Space, Launch, and Ground) and Concept Maturity Levels (CML 1–4), players tackle progressive Earth, lunar, and deep-space contracts or experiment freely in Sandbox Mode. details:
WHAT GOSPACE DOES & HOW IT WORKS

GoSpace is a single-player, full-screen 3D browser simulation that turns space systems engineering and orbital operations into an interactive decision-making game. Guided by an interactive 7-step spotlight tutorial, 6 progressive simulation contracts, and an open Sandbox Mode, players experience a complete four-stage mission lifecycle:

1. Hangar Assembly & Trade-Off Engineering: Structured around the four official space mission segments (User, Space, Launch, and Ground), players build custom CubeSats, SmallSats, or Flagship observatories from over 45 selectable parts, multi-slot instruments, rockets, and ground networks. Every choice dynamically updates a procedural 3D spacecraft alongside 6 live resource gauges (Budget, Mass, Power, Data, Lifetime, and Science) and a Concept Maturity Level (CML 1 to CML 4) readiness tracker. Players can also launch with design risks and face real physics debuffs in space—such as atmospheric drag decay from excess mass, eclipse battery brownouts, data bottlenecks, or a full 3D zero-G spacecraft breakup if hull integrity reaches 0%.

2. 3D Coastal Spaceport Launch: Once ready, players launch from a 3D coastal pad featuring water-deluge steam, supersonic rocket plumes, and atmospheric cloud layers into their selected trajectory.

3. Orbital Operations & Hazard Decisions: Upon orbital insertion, the spacecraft performs a mechanical zero-G unfolding sequence. Tracked by a live Mission Objectives & Active Debuffs sidebar, players use a live multi-mode Sensor Cam (Thermal IR, SAR Radar, Hyperspectral, and Magnetometer) to capture science over 3D target zones into an onboard buffer before downlinking packets over ground stations. Along the way, players resolve 3-choice Space Hazard emergencies (debris fields, solar storms, deep eclipses, and antenna jams) and inspect clickable Solar System Holo-Cards across the Sun, Moon, 8 planets, and asteroid belt.

4. Flight Debrief & Real Mission Match: Completing objectives unlocks an arcade Flight Review scoring player decisions, matching their build to real-world space missions, and offering a trajectory JSON export.

BENEFITS & INTENDED IMPACT

Spacecraft engineering relies on tightly coupled trade-offs that are difficult to grasp from textbooks alone. GoSpace makes cause-and-effect immediately visible—showing how payload choices ripple across mass, power, orbital survival, and science yield. Because it runs 100% in any standard web browser with zero installs, logins, or heavy asset downloads, GoSpace brings interactive 3D STEM and CubeSat education to students, classrooms, and aspiring engineers anywhere in the world.

HOW GOSPACE IS CREATIVE

GoSpace fuses systems-engineering frameworks (the 4 Mission Segments, Concept Maturity Levels, Mission Design Lab trade studies, and CubeSat 101 constraints) with arcade survival decisions in one cohesive 3D experience. Every satellite, planetary shader, plasma Sun, rocket plume, and adaptive space-synth soundtrack is generated 100% procedurally in code without external 3D model or audio files.

KEY FACTORS CONSIDERED

- Scientific Validity vs. Accessibility: Real Keplerian orbital mechanics (semi-major axis, eccentricity, inclination, apoapsis/periapsis, and Earth shadow eclipses) are paired with intuitive visual feedback, an interactive tutorial, and a 1-click Auto-Build reference option so beginners never feel overwhelmed.

- Pacing & Replayability: Per-pass scan and downlink cooldowns, Time Warp controls, risk-vs-reward hazard choices, and unrestricted Sandbox Mode encourage repeated experimentation.

- Zero-Crash Static Architecture: Built with pure relative paths and zero backend servers so judges and learners get instant, reliable performance on GitHub Pages.

TOOLS, CODING LANGUAGES & SOFTWARE USED

- Languages: HTML5, CSS3, Vanilla JavaScript (ES6+ Modules), custom GLSL shaders

- 3D Graphics & Physics: Three.js (v0.160.0), OrbitControls, RoomEnvironment PBR lighting, UnrealBloom post-processing, and a custom 3D Keplerian orbital propagator

- Audio & Storage: Procedural Web Audio API synthesizer and SFX engine, browser localStorage, JSON exporter

- Development & Hosting: Antigravity IDE (with AI-assisted code scaffolding), Git, and GitHub Pages
